subject: SKU consolidation discount request — HelioTech
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@heliotech.com>

Subject: SKU consolidation — ask for consolidated discount and packaging

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the chat earlier. We completed an internal SKU consolidation and are looking to collapse 12 separate endpoint SKUs into 3 larger bundles. Procurement asked me to send the ask formally so you have the specifics.

Summary:
- Current: 12 small SKUs across dev/prod and three regions; annual committed spend ~ $540k.
- Target: 3 consolidated SKUs (Core, Advanced, Enterprise) with an expected initial commit for year 1 of $720k (we plan to shift more usage onto consolidated SKUs in Q2).
- Ask: one-time commercial concession on list rates due to SKU consolidation and migration overhead. Raw ask from procurement: 25% off list for the first 12 months across consolidated SKUs, plus waived onboarding surcharge.

I've attached the SKU list we pulled together (heliotech_sku_list.xlsx). Procurement (cc) will follow up with any details.

Can you confirm internal next steps and whether this is something you can qualify for a commercial exception?

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of Cloud Partnerships
HelioTech

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: HelioTech SKU consolidation — request VP/CFO sign-off

Team —

HelioTech (see Sara, cc procurement) has formally requested a consolidation concession. Quick brief and ask:

Opportunity snapshot:
- Current ARR (run-rate): ~$540k; expected committed year-1 spend if consolidated: $720k (estimated increase driven by simplification and cross-product adoption).
- Strategic rationale: HelioTech is piloting Redwood across three new internal teams and consolidation removes operational friction. They are an influential reference in our cloud platform vertical.

Commercial ask from customer: 25% off list across consolidated SKUs for 12 months + waive onboarding surcharge (~$12k).

Financial impact and recommendation (attached pricing_model.csv for line-item math):
- Baseline list margin on bundle: ~58%.
- 25% off list would reduce gross margin by ~12-14 percentage points on year-1 committed ARR — roughly $86k of incremental margin erosion in year 1 (netting across expected uplift).
- However, modeled incremental committed revenue and projected 3-yr retention improvements give an NPV-positive outcome assuming 70% retention into year 2.

Recommended structured concession (to minimize precedent risk):
- Approved concession: up to 18% off list for first 12 months, conditional on:
  - A 12-month committed term with a 6-month minimum usage true-up;
  - Performance milestone: if consolidated usage exceeds 110% of committed tokens by month 9, a retroactive credit is reduced (protects volume upside).
  - Waive onboarding surcharge capped at $6k (half of their ask).
- Rationale: preserves margin vs. the raw 25% ask and gives commercial flexibility while still offering a material incentive to consolidate.

Approvals needed: VP/CFO sign-off for concession >15% and any onboarding waiver over $5k.

Attachments: pricing_model.csv

Ask: Marissa — can you confirm whether we can approve up to 18% with the above guardrails? If you prefer a different threshold (e.g., 15% + stronger milestone), please advise and we will present that back to procurement.

Thanks — Lukas

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: HelioTech SKU consolidation — request VP/CFO sign-off

Lukas — good summary. A few quick points and conditional sign-off:

1) We can approve a commercial concession up to 18% off list for the first 12 months, subject to the following stricter guardrails:
   - Commitment must be executed with a 12-month firm term and explicit true-up language at month 6 and month 12.
   - Onboarding surcharge waived up to $6k, beyond that must be escalated to Legal/Revenue Ops for a formal exception.
   - Add a rollback clause: if customer reduces contracted committed usage by >30% in the first 6 months, pricing reverts to list for future invoices.

2) Please convert the recommended concession into a short executive memo (one page) for the deal file and run the updated term sheet by Legal (Kimberly) before sending externally.

3) Karthik: please confirm that Sales will require a business reference commitment (customer agree to a short case study / anonymized metrics share) in exchange for the concession. If HelioTech balks, we should reduce the concession to 15%.

If the above is in place, consider this a conditional approval. Please move to finalize with Sara and Procurement.

Marissa Cole
VP Finance (Commercial) | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@heliotech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@heliotech.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SKU consolidation — ask for consolidated discount and packaging

Sara — thanks for the patience. We ran this through Finance and Sales Ops. High-level outcome we can offer today (conditional):

Offer (REV A):
- Commercial concession: 18% off list on consolidated SKUs for the first 12 months.
- Commitment: 12-month firm term with true-up at month 6 and month 12.
- Onboarding surcharge: waived up to $6,000.
- Performance guardrails: if consolidated usage falls >30% vs. contracted commit within first 6 months, pricing reverts to list for future invoices; if usage exceeds 110% of committed tokens by month 9, we will discuss a retroactive uplift credit to share upside.
- Marketing ask: in exchange for the concession, we request a short case study or anonymized metrics share post-Q2 adoption.

Next steps:
1) Procurement — please confirm acceptance of the above commercial points and whether you want the revised term sheet redlined (attached: redwood_proposed_term_sheet_revA.pdf).
2) Kimberly (Legal) — please run the attached and confirm the rollback/true-up language is phrased correctly.
3) Karthik — I will book time to walk the customer through the Rev A and capture the case study agreement.

If procurement signs off we will route the final term sheet to DocuSign and target an execution window of 10 business days.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_proposed_term_sheet_revA.pdf
